sense: not taken: of a seat or a room

terms.gloss: be free, be empty, not be taken
terms.grammar: verb, first conjugation; of a place
evidence: Cic. Att. 13.52.1: ut vix triclīnium … vacāret
terms.comment: The same verb serves for a person who is free (see available, of a person). A seat in a theatre is locus (Cic. Sen. 63).

phrases.latin: vīlla ita complēta ā mīlitibus est ut vix triclīnium ubi cēnātūrus ipse Caesar esset vacāret
phrases.english: the house was so full of soldiers that hardly a dining room was left free for Caesar himself to dine in

sources: Lewis & Short: vaco · Lewis & Short: vacuus
Cicero (Att. 13.52.1) checked against the Perseus Latin texts; Cicero (Sen. 63) from the Latinitas loci collection (loci-cicero-philosophica).
